title: User account
purpose: Create or maintain a staff or client account while preserving attributed laboratory history.
summary: Create or change one staff or client account: identity, client link, role groups, permissions and active state.

tasks.title: Create an account
steps: Enter [[Username]] and [[Email address]], then set a password or turn off password-based authentication.
For a client user, choose the [[Client]]. For staff, leave it blank and choose [[Groups]].
Select [[Save]]. The form reopens with the remaining options.

tasks.title: Give or remove a role
steps: Move groups between Available groups and Chosen groups under [[Groups]], then select [[Save]].

tasks.title: Grant release permission
steps: Under [[User permissions]], choose the authorize_release permission, or add a group that grants it. Then save.

tasks.title: Stop someone from signing in
steps: Clear [[Active]] and save. Accounts are never deleted.

good_to_know: Staff status and Superuser status grant no laboratory role and no release authority.
Clear the client link before giving an account staff flags, groups or permissions.
You cannot demote or deactivate the last active superuser.
There is no protection against another administrator's save: a later save replaces earlier values.
Account and role changes are recorded in the audit history, without password values.

sections.title: Access and page variants
paragraphs: The administration site requires an active account with Staff status. User and group pages additionally require Superuser status; a laboratory admin role alone or individual model permissions do not open them. These technical flags do not themselves confer operational roles or report-release authority.

Add user includes Username, Email address, Password-based authentication, Password, Password confirmation, Client, Groups, Staff status and Superuser status. New users default to Active even though Active is not on this add form. After creation the change form exposes the remaining account options. Change user groups fields into Personal info, Client access, Laboratory roles, Account status and technical access, and Important dates.

items.label: Username
items.description: Required unique identifier, at most 150 characters; Unicode letters and digits plus @/./+/-/_ are accepted. Saving creation rejects case-insensitive duplicates; ordinary edit uses the model’s exact username uniqueness constraint.

items.label: Email address
items.description: Required syntactically valid unique account email in both add and change forms. This field is not an EmailAddress verification record or a project reporting contact. Creation does not send an invitation or verification email.

items.label: Password-based authentication
items.description: Creation only: Enabled by default or Disabled. Enabled requires both password fields; Disabled sets an unusable password and ignores them. No alternative login provider is configured by this choice.

items.label: Password / Password confirmation
items.description: Creation: required matching password when Enabled. Minimum eight characters, account-similarity, common-password and numeric-only checks apply.

items.label: Password
items.description: Change only: read-only password-hash status, never the original secret. Reset password or Set password opens the separate administrator password form; changing this display is not password entry.

items.label: First name / Last name
items.description: Change only; optional, each at most 150 characters, used for operator display and searching.

items.label: Client
items.description: Optional client selection. Blank means internal laboratory account; a selected client limits portal records to that client. Clear the link before granting staff flags, groups or permissions. Related-object maintenance shortcuts appear only when their registered model and permission allow them.

items.label: Groups
items.description: Optional assigned groups in Available groups and Chosen groups, with filter boxes, choose/remove controls and Choose all/Remove all. Built-in group names determine roles. Custom groups can carry explicit permissions without becoming operational roles.

items.label: Active
items.description: Change only; controls whether the account may authenticate and have operational access. Clear instead of deleting a historical contributor.

items.label: Staff status
items.description: Allows the maintenance-site entry check; does not grant laboratory roles, superuser status or model permissions.

items.label: Superuser status
items.description: Enables Django permission bypass for administration; does not grant laboratory roles or explicit report-release authority.

items.label: User permissions
items.description: Change only. Available user permissions/Chosen user permissions assign explicit capabilities including accounts authorize_release. Groups can grant the same capability. Model permissions do not replace laboratory role/ownership checks.

items.label: Last login
items.description: Change only; optional date and time, editable, with standard date/time widgets. It is not a complete login history.

items.label: Date joined
items.description: Change only; required date and time, defaults to account creation, editable.

sections.title: Integrity and history
paragraphs: Client isolation, last-active-superuser preservation and immutable historical actors are checked by this administration implementation. Existing built-in groups cannot be renamed in group editing. Only active internal users with explicit release permission may release reports, and contributors cannot review their own results. Account/role changes are audited with before/after snapshots; secret values are omitted. This form has no optimistic original-version token: a valid later save can replace another editor’s values.

items.label: Save
items.description: On Add user, saves and normally opens the new change form so you can edit remaining options. On Change user, saves and returns to the user list. Popup creation returns the selection to its opener.

items.label: Save and continue editing
items.description: Saves and opens the user change form.

items.label: Save and add another
items.description: Saves and starts a new user add form.

items.label: History
items.description: Change only: opens Django object administration history.

items.label: Delete
items.description: Never available for users; direct deletion is refused.

items.label: Home / app / Users / View site
items.description: Breadcrumbs return through administration; View site returns to the operational application. Validation errors retain non-secret form input for correction.
